title: stabilizer-qec: a quantum error-correction simulator and decoder
description: A quantum error-correction simulator and decoder in Rust, with Python bindings. Circuits and detector error models in Stim's formats (error models and generated circuits identical to Stim's, character for character), a bit-parallel sampler, exact sparse-blossom, correlated and belief matching, union-find, BP and BP+OSD, window decoders for real time and memories of millions of rounds, circuit diagrams, IBM's bivariate bicycle codes, any CSS code from its checks (hypergraph products, colour codes), lattice surgery, and a fault-tolerant resource estimate. Release 2.0 adds the APIs of Stim, PyMatching, sinter, ldpc and twenty-one more QEC tools under their own names, Clifford+T circuits with a coherent error on every gate (stabilizer-rank and joint samplers), fault-tolerant compilation (tqec, Loom), resource estimates (Azure, Qualtran), decoding as a service, and sampling and BP on the GPU. Checked against Stim, PyMatching, ldpc, Tsim and Google's Willow and Sycamore hardware data.
